day_read: Steady down-trend day: Nifty -0.83% from open and sitting in the bottom 13% of its range, breadth 13/37 and most sectors red. The volume is thin and grinding rather than impulsive, so fades and breakouts have bled while the trend-aligned rsi2, squeeze_break and short liq_run have paid. With about 28 minutes left before the 14:50 flat, only quick, trend-aligned trades can reach target.

bollinger_fade.why: Worst or near-worst on 4 of the last 5 days with 80-100 trades; charges eat it in low volatility

rsi2.why: Steady winner at 20 of 28 and +1879. It already trades with the 20-EMA, so leave it alone.

vwap_revert.why: Base, inverse and @ai all lose (@ai -2635 on 2 wins in 11). Fading toward VWAP fights a one-way tape, so there is no edge worth the charges.

volume_burst.why: Still losing even with tighter filters (-799, 5 wins in 12). Base and inverse both lose too, so the bursts carry no edge and charges eat it. Stop the bleed.

vwap_trend.why: @ai is -2055 inverted, the base is -2046 and the inverse is only +35 on 26 trades. Thin-volume VWAP crossing has no edge in either direction, and charges eat it. Stop the bleed.

orb.why: @ai is -3119. The inverted variants win often but net about zero after charges, and the opening ranges are long since broken. Stop the bleed.

opening_drive_fade.why: The opening drive was too small to fade. @ai lost -1295 at 0.5 and the base also lost, so there is no edge worth the charges.

ema_cross.why: @ai is only +4 on 3 trades. A fresh 5-minute crossover this late has too little time to reach a 3 ATR target, so it would mostly pay charges.

liq_run.why: Short-only runs are working at +1001, but price is already near the lows with the 25,500 put wall below. Take the quicker target in the time left.

liq_sweep.why: This has collapsed since the morning: @ai is -3862 on 6 wins in 27 and the base is -2823. Breaks of the low pools are holding (liq_run is positive), so reversal fades are fighting the tape.

squeeze_break.why: Winning at +1480. Trim the target so any late breakout can actually hit it before the 14:50 square-off.
